{"consolidated_memory":"CACHE MISS STORMS IN BUILD SYSTEM - TWO INCIDENTS

Component: build/bazel/BUILD.bazel (Starlark stack, monitored via remote cache hit rate check in CI)

**INCIDENT 1: April 17, 2026**
- Problem: Cache miss storm in build graph
- Repro: build twice with no source change
- Signal: unnecessary rebuild of targets that should have been cached
- Manifestation: only triggered for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: off-by-one error in the slice bound
- Fix: corrected the boundary and added a property test around it (PR #1171 on branch fix/cache-miss-storm-1)
- Outcome: reclaimed 92 GB of blob storage

**INCIDENT 2: August 13, 2026**
- Problem: Cache miss storm in build graph
- Repro: build twice with no source change
- Signal: unnecessary rebuild of targets that should have been cached
- Manifestation: only triggered after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it (PR #3256 on branch fix/cache-miss-storm-2)
- Outcome: alert stayed quiet for 5 consecutive days

Both incidents share the same symptom (spurious cache misses) but have different underlying causes and required separate solutions."}
